D- Phenylalanyl-L-cysteinyl-L-tyrosyl-D-tryptophyl-L-lysyl-L-valyl-L- cysteinyl-L-tryptophanamide cyclic (2→7)-disulfide. Вапреотид C57H70N12O9S2 = 1131.4. CAS — 103222-11-3. ATC — H01CB04. ATC Vet — QH01CB04. Profile Vapreotide is a somatostatin analogue similar to octreotide (p.1803). It is under investigation in the management of various disorders, including bleeding oesophageal varices, gastrointesti- nal and pancreatic fistulas, acromegaly, carcinoid tumours, and for the prevention of postoperative complications following pan- creatic surgery. ◊ References. 1.
